proposed_widenings.name: elapsed_days_full_regain
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing elapsed-days reset shape cannot survive the required Dhall-to-JSON flow when the item regains all uses after the cooldown; `dhall-to-json --omit-empty` drops `regain = null`, and the tracer then crashes instead of emitting a graph.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The manual then loses its magic but regains it in a century.

notes: The unit fits the existing magic_item activation family honestly: study 48 hours within 6 days, one use, century recharge, and modify_ability_score +2 Dex to max 30. `pnpm typecheck` passed, but `pnpm exec tsx src/run.ts content/magic_item_manual_of_quickness_of_action.json --out ...` crashed in `traceResetCadence` because `resetCadence.elapsed_days` omitted `regain` in the generated JSON. No trace file was produced.
